# Mailcraft Studio

> Mailcraft Studio sells the Email Marketing Starter Kit: 11 production HTML email templates plus Brand and Content Wizards for applying brand tokens and campaign copy before pasting into an ESP (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and other custom-HTML ESPs).

## Primary sources

- [Home](https://www.mailcraft.studio/): Product overview and workflow (brand → content → ESP)
- [Email Marketing Starter Kit](https://www.mailcraft.studio/products): Pricing, features, and purchase
- [User Guide](https://www.mailcraft.studio/docs): How-to walkthroughs for Brand Wizard, Content Wizard, fonts, Design Rules, and ESP variables
- [FAQ](https://www.mailcraft.studio/docs/faq): Direct answers on branding, wizards, ESP upload, Outlook, and purchases
- [Contact](https://www.mailcraft.studio/contact): Support email for downloads and order help

## Product facts

- Product name: Email Marketing Starter Kit
- Template count: 11 production HTML files
- Price: $79.99 USD
- Brand Wizard: apply logo, colors, buttons, footer, and fonts across a zip
- Content Wizard: fill headlines, body, CTAs, and images for one layout; download filled HTML
- Output: ESP-ready HTML (table layouts, inline CSS, Outlook VML button fallbacks)
